annotation.title_clean: Executive Order 13960: Promoting the Use of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Federal Government
annotation.title_en: Executive Order 13960: Promoting the Use of Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Federal Government
annotation.authors_or_issuer: The White House (President of the United States)
named_instruments_referenced: ODNI Principles of AI Ethics for the Intelligence Community
annotation.summary_en: US Executive Order 13960 (December 2020) sets nine principles for federal agencies' non-defense use of AI, including lawful, accurate, safe, understandable, accountable and transparent AI. It requires OMB guidance, agency AI use-case inventories, interagency coordination and AI expertise programs. It excludes defense, national security and R&D.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sec. 3 sets nine principles for federal AI use, including safe, secure, resilient, transparent and accountable.
OMB must publish a roadmap for AI policy guidance within 180 days.
Agencies must inventory non-classified AI use cases annually and publish them.
Agencies must retire or bring into compliance AI applications inconsistent with the order.
Excludes defense, national security systems, commercial embedded AI and R&D.
